description: Record the user's decision about whether Review Assist may operate in a repository: read its coding sessions and write its Intent Document. Call this only after the user has answered the consent prompt (from compute_diff, a session-reading tool, or submit_document). Pass `run_id` whenever you have one: a "once" recorded on the run holds for every agent working on that change, not just this one.

decision.description: always = enable and remember; once = allow it for this change and this session; never = disable and remember

repo.description: Absolute repo path, when there is no run. Defaults to REVIEW_ASSIST_REPO or cwd.

run_id.description: Run handle from compute_diff. Names the repository, and carries a "once" to the other role.

name: set_consent
title: Record consent for a repository
